title: A Spatiotemporal Semantic Importance-Guided Unified Compression and Editing Framework for AI-Generated Videos
title_zh: 一种基于时空语义重要性的统一压缩与编辑框架：面向人工智能生成视频

paragraphs.en: AI-generated videos are rapidly increasing in volume, duration, and resolution, creating growing demands for efficient storage and transmission. Unlike natural videos captured from the physical world, AI-generated videos are samples from a learned generative distribution, where semantic structures are critical to content consistency, while many local textures and stochastic details can be plausibly regenerated. This distinction suggests that compression should preserve semantically important spatiotemporal information rather than reconstruct every pixel of a particular generative sample. Beyond reconstruction, AI-generated videos also create a practical need for prompt-based editing, where users expect to modify generated content while preserving its original spatiotemporal semantics. Motivated by these observations, we propose a unified compression and editing framework for AI-generated videos that incorporates a frozen video generator as a reusable generative prior. Within this framework, we design three spatiotemporal semantic importance-guided techniques that respectively address what to transmit, how much to transmit, and how to use the transmitted side information. First, an innovation selection method projects the latent discrepancy using spatiotemporal semantic importance, so that the selected innovations prioritize semantic invariants over replaceable generative variations. Second, a frame-adaptive bit allocation method estimates the nonuniform semantic demands of latent frames and allocates more innovations to frames requiring stronger semantic preservation. Third, a unified reconstruction and editing method continuously adjusts the influence of the transmitted side information, enabling the same compressed representation to provide strong guidance for faithful reconstruction or serve as a flexible semantic anchor for structure-preserving prompt-driven editing. Extensive experiments on videos generated by multiple video generation models show that our codec achieves superior rate-perception performance over traditional, neural, and generative video codecs, while enabling structure-preserving prompt-based editing from the same bitstream.
paragraphs.zh: 人工智能生成的视频在数量、时长和分辨率上迅速增长，从而对高效的存储和传输提出了日益增长的需求。 与从物理世界捕获的自然视频不同，人工智能生成的视频是从已学习的生成分布中抽取的样本，其中语义结构对内容一致性至关重要，而许多局部纹理和随机细节则可以被合理地重新生成。 这种差异表明，压缩应保留具有语义重要性的时空信息，而非重建特定生成样本中的每一个像素。 除了重建之外，人工智能生成的视频还催生了基于提示编辑的实际需求，用户希望能够在保留其原始时空语义的同时修改生成内容。 基于这些观察，我们提出了一种适用于人工智能生成视频的统一压缩与编辑框架，该框架将冻结的视频生成器作为可重复使用的生成先验纳入其中。 在此框架内，我们设计了三种由时空语义重要性引导的技术，分别解决“传输什么”、“传输多少”以及“如何使用传输的侧信息”这三个问题。 首先，一种创新选择方法利用时空语义重要性对潜在差异进行投影，使得所选的创新优先保留语义不变量，而非可替换的生成变体。 其次，一种帧自适应比特分配方法能够估算潜在帧之间不均匀的语义需求，并将更多创新分配给需要更强语义保留的帧。 第三，一种统一的重建与编辑方法能够持续调整传输侧信息的影响程度，使得同一压缩表示既能对忠实重建提供强引导，也能作为灵活的语义锚点，支持结构保留的提示驱动式编辑。 在由多种视频生成模型生成的视频上进行的广泛实验表明，我们的编解码器在速率-感知性能方面优于传统、神经和生成式视频编解码器，同时还能从同一比特流中实现结构保留的基于提示的编辑。

paragraphs.en: Artificial Intelligence (AI) video generation is emerging as a new paradigm for content creation. It is becoming increasingly popular across a wide range of applications such as short-form video creation and advertising. As AI-generated videos rapidly grow in volume, duration, and resolution, they are creating substantial storage and transmission demands. This raises a direct but underexplored problem: how should AI-generated videos be compressed?
paragraphs.zh: 人工智能（AI）视频生成正成为内容创作的一种新范式。 它在短视频制作和广告等广泛应用中日益流行。 随着AI生成视频的规模、时长和分辨率迅速增长，它们也带来了巨大的存储和传输需求。 这直接引出了一个尚未充分研究的问题：AI生成的视频应该如何压缩？

sents.en: Artificial Intelligence (AI) video generation is emerging as a new paradigm for content creation.
sents.zh: 人工智能（AI）视频生成正成为内容创作的一种新范式。

sents.en: It is becoming increasingly popular across a wide range of applications such as short-form video creation and advertising.
sents.zh: 它在短视频制作和广告等广泛应用中日益流行。

sents.en: As AI-generated videos rapidly grow in volume, duration, and resolution, they are creating substantial storage and transmission demands.
sents.zh: 随着AI生成视频的规模、时长和分辨率迅速增长，它们也带来了巨大的存储和传输需求。

sents.en: This raises a direct but underexplored problem: how should AI-generated videos be compressed?
sents.zh: 这直接引出了一个尚未充分研究的问题：AI生成的视频应该如何压缩？

paragraphs.en: Existing video coding methods [ 1 , 2 , 3 ] mostly assume that videos are natural signals captured by cameras. A natural video records the physical world: object boundaries, textures, motion trajectories, and illumination changes all come from a real scene, and the goal of compression is to preserve this external signal under a bitrate constraint. AI-generated videos are fundamentally different. They are not measurements of a real scene, but samples drawn from the distribution learned by a generative model [ 4 ] . In such videos, identity, layout, object relations, and motion trends usually define the spatiotemporal semantics of the content, while many local textures, small appearance changes, and stochastic details are only one possible realization of the generation process. In other words, not all pixel-level differences in an AI-generated video are equally meaningful: some differences break identity, silhouette, or motion consistency, while others can be regenerated differently and still remain plausible. Directly compressing AI-generated videos as natural videos therefore ignores the statistical origin and semantic structure of generated content. This distinction changes the coding objective. For AI-generated videos, the goal should not be to reconstruct every pixel, but to preserve the information that determines semantic consistency.
paragraphs.zh: 现有的视频编码方法 [ 1 , 2 , 3 ] 大多假设视频是由摄像头捕捉到的自然信号。 自然视频记录的是物理世界：物体边界、纹理、运动轨迹和光照变化都来自真实场景，而压缩的目标是在比特率约束下保留这种外部信号。 人工智能生成的视频在根本上有所不同。 它们并非对真实场景的测量结果，而是从生成模型 [ 4 ] 所学习到的分布中抽取的样本。 在这类视频中，身份、布局、物体关系和运动趋势通常定义了内容的时空语义，而许多局部纹理、细微外观变化和随机细节只是生成过程的一种可能实现。 换言之，人工智能生成视频中的并非所有像素级差异都具有同等意义：某些差异会破坏身份、轮廓或运动一致性，而另一些差异则可以被重新生成不同形式，但仍保持合理性。 因此，将人工智能生成的视频直接作为自然视频进行压缩，会忽略其统计起源和生成内容的语义结构。 这种区别改变了编码的目标。 对于人工智能生成的视频，目标不应是重建每个像素，而是保留决定语义一致性的信息。

paragraphs.en: Beyond reconstruction, this semantic view also changes how a compressed bitstream can be used at the receiver side. In conventional video coding, the bitstream is primarily designed for decoded playback. When further modifications are desired, such as transferring the style, changing object attributes, removing the watermarks of the generated video while preserving its original structure and motion, a separate editing model is commonly applied to the reconstructed video. Such a model needs to analyze the video again, for example by encoding it into a latent space to extract the structural and motion information required for prompt-based editing [ 5 , 6 , 7 , 8 , 9 ] . However, this spatiotemporal semantic information has already been conveyed by the compressed bitstream. Re-extracting it from the reconstructed video therefore introduces redundant processing and additional computational complexity. In this setting, the compressed bitstream should not merely describe a one-time reconstruction. It should also carry reusable semantic constraints that support controlled editing.
paragraphs.zh: 除了重建之外，这种语义视角还改变了压缩比特流在接收端的使用方式。 在传统视频编码中，比特流主要是为解码播放而设计的。 当需要进行进一步修改时，例如转移风格、改变物体属性、移除生成视频的 водяные знаки 同时保留其原始结构和运动，通常会针对重建后的视频应用一个独立的编辑模型。 这样的模型需要再次分析视频，例如通过将其编码到潜在空间中，以提取基于提示词编辑所需的结构和运动信息 [ 5 , 6 , 7 , 8 , 9 ] 。 然而，这种时空语义信息已经通过压缩比特流传递了。 因此，从重建后的视频中重新提取这些信息会引入冗余处理和额外的计算复杂性。 在这种情况下，压缩比特流不应仅仅描述一次性的重建过程。 它还应该携带可重复使用的语义约束，以支持受控的编辑操作。

paragraphs.en: Video generation models [ 10 , 11 , 12 ] provide a new opportunity to realize these goals. A video generator [ 13 , 14 , 15 ] has learned to transform noisy latent variables into video content with plausible appearance, structure, and motion. When a frozen video generator is integrated into a codec, it can serve as a reusable video prior: the generator restores replaceable details, while the bitstream only needs to transmit compact side information that constrains the generation process toward the source video. In this sense, compression no longer has to independently describe the complete video signal. Meanwhile, because the generator is prompt-conditioned, the same side information can be combined with a user-defined prompt to produce an edited video that follows the editing intention while preserving the source spatiotemporal semantics. This forms a unified AI-generated video coding framework, where one compressed representation supports both high-quality reconstruction and prompt-based editing, without training a new compression model or introducing a separate post-reconstruction editing model.
paragraphs.zh: 视频生成模型 [ 10 , 11 , 12 ] 为实现这些目标提供了新的机遇。 一种视频生成器 [ 13 , 14 , 15 ] 已经学会将噪声潜伏变量转化为具有合理外观、结构和运动特征的视频内容。 当将冻结的视频生成器集成到编解码器中时，它可以充当可重用的视频先验：该生成器负责恢复可替换的细节，而比特流只需传输紧凑的侧信息，以引导生成过程朝向源视频靠拢。 从这个意义上说，压缩不再需要独立地完整描述整个视频信号。 同时，由于该生成器受提示条件约束，相同的侧信息可以与用户自定义的提示相结合，从而生成既符合编辑意图又保留源视频时空语义的编辑后视频。 这构成了一个统一的 AI 生成视频编码框架：其中一种压缩表示既能支持高质量的重建，也能支持基于提示的编辑，而无需训练新的压缩模型或引入独立的重建后编辑模型。

paragraphs.en: However, turning this opportunity into a practical codec faces three key problems. First, side-information selection needs to account for spatiotemporal semantic importance. If information is selected only according to latent errors, the bitstream may spend bits on replaceable stochastic textures instead of protecting the semantic structures that determine content consistency. Second, the side-information budget needs to reflect the nonuniform spatiotemporal semantic importance of latent frames. Uniform allocation may waste bits on semantically stable frames with substantial temporal redundancy, while providing insufficient information for frames that require stronger semantic preservation. Third, reconstruction and editing impose different requirements on the same side information. Reconstruction needs strong constraints to recover the source video, while editing needs sufficient flexibility to follow a new prompt. Overly rigid constraints suppress editing, whereas overly weak constraints cause structural drift. Therefore, the codec needs a controllable mechanism for using the same bitstream under different reconstruction and editing requirements.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，要将这一机会转化为实用的编解码器，还需解决三个关键问题。 首先，侧信息的选取需要考虑时空语义的重要性。 如果仅根据潜在错误来选择信息，比特流可能会将比特浪费在可替换的随机纹理上，而非用于保护决定内容一致性的语义结构。 其次，侧信息预算需要反映潜在帧非均匀的时空语义重要性。 均匀分配可能会在语义稳定的、具有大量时间冗余的帧上浪费比特，同时无法为需要更强语义保留的帧提供足够的信息。 第三，重建和编辑对同一侧信息提出了不同的要求。 重建需要强约束以恢复源视频，而编辑则需要足够的灵活性来遵循新的提示。 过于僵化的约束会抑制编辑，而过于宽松的约束则会导致结构漂移。 因此，编解码器需要一种可控机制，以便在不同重建和编辑要求下使用相同的比特流。

sents.en: However, turning this opportunity into a practical codec faces three key problems.
sents.zh: 然而，要将这一机会转化为实用的编解码器，还需解决三个关键问题。

sents.en: First, side-information selection needs to account for spatiotemporal semantic importance.
sents.zh: 首先，侧信息的选取需要考虑时空语义的重要性。

sents.en: If information is selected only according to latent errors, the bitstream may spend bits on replaceable stochastic textures instead of protecting the semantic structures that determine content consistency.
sents.zh: 如果仅根据潜在错误来选择信息，比特流可能会将比特浪费在可替换的随机纹理上，而非用于保护决定内容一致性的语义结构。

sents.en: Second, the side-information budget needs to reflect the nonuniform spatiotemporal semantic importance of latent frames.
sents.zh: 其次，侧信息预算需要反映潜在帧非均匀的时空语义重要性。

sents.en: Uniform allocation may waste bits on semantically stable frames with substantial temporal redundancy, while providing insufficient information for frames that require stronger semantic preservation.
sents.zh: 均匀分配可能会在语义稳定的、具有大量时间冗余的帧上浪费比特，同时无法为需要更强语义保留的帧提供足够的信息。

sents.en: Third, reconstruction and editing impose different requirements on the same side information.
sents.zh: 第三，重建和编辑对同一侧信息提出了不同的要求。

sents.en: Reconstruction needs strong constraints to recover the source video, while editing needs sufficient flexibility to follow a new prompt.
sents.zh: 重建需要强约束以恢复源视频，而编辑则需要足够的灵活性来遵循新的提示。

sents.en: Overly rigid constraints suppress editing, whereas overly weak constraints cause structural drift.
sents.zh: 过于僵化的约束会抑制编辑，而过于宽松的约束则会导致结构漂移。

sents.en: Therefore, the codec needs a controllable mechanism for using the same bitstream under different reconstruction and editing requirements.
sents.zh: 因此，编解码器需要一种可控机制，以便在不同重建和编辑要求下使用相同的比特流。

paragraphs.en: To address these problems, we propose a spatiotemporal semantic importance-guided unified compression and editing framework for AI-generated videos. First, we propose a spatiotemporal semantic importance-guided innovation selection method to determine what information should be transmitted. It projects the latent discrepancy according to spatiotemporal semantic importance and selects innovations that prioritize semantic invariants over replaceable generative variations. Second, we propose a spatiotemporal semantic importance-guided bit allocation method to determine how much information should be assigned to each latent frame. It evaluates frame-level semantic demand and allocates more innovations to frames requiring stronger semantic preservation. Third, we propose a spatiotemporal semantic importance-constrained unified reconstruction and editing method to determine how the transmitted side information should be used at the receiver. It continuously adjusts the influence of the bitstream constraint, allowing the same compressed representation to provide strong guidance for source reconstruction or serve as a flexible semantic anchor for prompt-driven editing.
paragraphs.zh: 为解决这些问题，我们提出了一种基于时空语义重要性的统一压缩与编辑框架，用于处理人工智能生成的视频。 首先，我们提出了一种基于时空语义重要性的创新选择方法，用以确定哪些信息应当被传输。 该方法根据时空语义重要性对潜在差异进行投影，并优先选择保留语义不变量而非可替换生成变化的创新内容。 其次，我们提出了一种基于时空语义重要性的比特分配方法，用以确定每个潜在帧应分配多少信息。 该方法评估各帧的语义需求，并将更多创新资源分配给需要更强语义保留的帧。 第三，我们提出了一种受时空语义重要性约束的统一重建与编辑方法，用以确定接收端应如何使用所传输的侧信息。 该方法持续调整比特流约束的影响，使得相同的压缩表示既能对源视频的重建提供强引导，也能作为提示驱动编辑的灵活语义锚点。

paragraphs.zh: 总而言之，我们的主要贡献有三点：

paragraphs.en: We propose, to the best of our knowledge, the first unified compression and editing framework specifically designed for AI-generated videos, where one compact bitstream supports both high-quality reconstruction and structure-preserving prompt-based editing.
paragraphs.zh: 据我们所知，我们提出了首个专为人工智能生成视频设计的统一压缩与编辑框架，其中一条紧凑的比特流既能支持高质量的重建，也能支持保留结构的提示式编辑。

paragraphs.en: We propose three spatiotemporal semantic importance-guided techniques: an innovation selection method that prioritizes semantically critical latent information, a frame-adaptive bit allocation method that adapts the innovation budget to frame-level semantic demand, and a unified reconstruction and editing method that balances transmitted spatiotemporal semantics with prompt-induced editing semantics.

paragraphs.en: Generative video compression reconstructs perceptually realistic videos at low bitrates by incorporating generative priors into the codec. Existing work can be grouped into generative adversarial network (GAN) [ 16 ] -based, vector-quantization-based, visual autoregressive-based, diffusion-based, and training-free methods.
paragraphs.zh: 生成式视频压缩通过将生成先验融入编解码器，以低码率重建出在感知上逼真的视频。 现有研究可归为基于生成对抗网络（GAN）[ 16 ]、基于向量量化、基于视觉自回归、基于扩散模型以及无需训练的方法。

sents.en: Generative video compression reconstructs perceptually realistic videos at low bitrates by incorporating generative priors into the codec.
sents.zh: 生成式视频压缩通过将生成先验融入编解码器，以低码率重建出在感知上逼真的视频。

sents.en: Existing work can be grouped into generative adversarial network (GAN) [ 16 ] -based, vector-quantization-based, visual autoregressive-based, diffusion-based, and training-free methods.
sents.zh: 现有研究可归为基于生成对抗网络（GAN）[ 16 ]、基于向量量化、基于视觉自回归、基于扩散模型以及无需训练的方法。

paragraphs.en: GAN-based methods introduce adversarial learning into learned video compression to improve perceptual realism at low bitrates. Mentzer et al. [ 17 ] proposed the first GAN-based neural video compression system, where detail synthesis is conditioned on the warped previous reconstruction and then propagated through optical flow, showing that adversarial learning is crucial for subjective visual quality. Yang et al. [ 18 ] proposed a recurrent conditional GAN-based video codec, in which the discriminator is conditioned on spatial-temporal features, encouraging reconstructions to be both photo-realistic and temporally coherent. Li et al. [ 19 ] proposed to improve visual fidelity by enhancing newly emerged regions with confidence-based feature reconstruction and suppressing checkerboard artifacts with a periodic compensation loss. Du et al. [ 20 ] proposed to combine contextual coding, transformer-convolution autoencoders, entropy modeling, and GAN-based perceptual enhancement for generative video compression. Liang et al. [ 21 ] proposed a rank-chain GAN loss function to improve perceptual quality across variable bitrates. These methods demonstrate that adversarial learning can effectively improve perceptual quality.
paragraphs.zh: 基于GAN的方法将对抗性学习引入到学习型视频压缩中，从而在低码率下提升感知真实感。Mentzer等人 [ 17 ]提出了首个基于GAN的神经视频压缩系统，其中细节合成以变形后的先前重建结果为条件，并通过光流传播，表明对抗性学习对主观视觉质量至关重要。Yang等人 [ 18 ]提出了一种循环条件GAN视频编解码器，其判别器以时空特征为条件，促使重建结果既具有照片级真实感，又具备时间连贯性。Li等人 [ 19 ]提出通过基于置信度的特征重建来增强新出现的区域，并利用周期性补偿损失抑制棋盘格伪影，从而提升视觉保真度。Du等人 [ 20 ]提出将上下文编码、Transformer-卷积自编码器、熵建模和基于GAN的感知增强相结合，用于生成式视频压缩。Liang等人 [ 21 ]提出了一种秩链GAN损失函数，以提升不同码率下的感知质量。 这些方法表明，对抗性学习可以有效提升感知质量。

paragraphs.en: Vector-quantization-based methods shift video compression from the pixel domain to a generative latent or token space. Qi et al. [ 22 ] proposed a method that performs image and video compression in the latent space of a generative VQ-VAE, showing that such a space is sparser, more semantic, and better aligned with perceptual quality than pixel space at ultra-low bitrates. Guo et al. [ 23 ] further explored continuous generative tokenization for perceptual video compression, where a pretrained tokenizer projects video frames into a perceptually aligned latent domain and the codec is redesigned around this representation. Zheng et al. [ 24 ] proposed to represent videos with compact one-dimensional latent tokens, allowing the codec to reduce spatial redundancy and model long-term temporal context through a lightweight memory mechanism. Dang et al. [ 25 ] pursued real-time generative video compression by designing a token-based codec with efficient generative reconstruction. These methods show that generative token spaces can improve perceptual compression by representing videos with more compact and semantically meaningful units.
paragraphs.zh: 基于向量量化的方法将视频压缩从像素域转移到了生成性潜在空间或令牌空间中。Qi 等人 [ 22 ] 提出了一种在生成性 VQ-VAE 的潜在空间中对图像和视频进行压缩的方法，结果表明，在极低码率下，这种空间比像素空间更稀疏、更具语义性，且与感知质量更为契合。Guo 等人 [ 23 ] 进一步探索了用于感知视频压缩的连续生成性令牌化方法，其中预训练的令牌化器将视频帧投影到与感知对齐的潜在域中，而编解码器则围绕这种表示进行重新设计。Zheng 等人 [ 24 ] 提出用紧凑的一维潜在令牌来表示视频，使编解码器能够通过轻量级的记忆机制减少空间冗余并建模长期的时间上下文。Dang 等人 [ 25 ] 通过设计一种基于令牌的编解码器，结合高效的生成性重建，实现了实时生成性视频压缩。 这些方法表明，生成性令牌空间可以通过用更紧凑且更具语义意义的单元来表示视频，从而提升感知压缩效果。

[ 26 ] proposed to encode videos into hierarchical residual token maps, where coarse tokens are transmitted for progressive reconstruction and fine-scale tokens can be predicted by an autoregressive context model at the decoder. This design links progressive transmission, entropy modeling, and generative detail synthesis within a token prediction framework.

paragraphs.en: Diffusion-based methods exploit diffusion or flow-based priors to synthesize perceptually plausible details at low bitrates. Mao et al. [ 27 ] used a video diffusion prior for sequence-level generative refinement, improving temporal stability over frame-wise generative enhancement. Gao et al. [ 28 ] incorporated diffusion sampling into implicit neural representations for coarse-to-fine spatiotemporal reconstruction. Zhang et al. [ 29 ] designed a spatio-temporal diffusion framework to reduce error accumulation and handle semantic mutation during low-bitrate reconstruction. Xue et al. [ 30 ] developed a single-step diffusion codec with semantic-temporal guidance to improve reconstruction efficiency and temporal coherence. Ma et al. [ 31 , 32 , 33 ] studied real-time and one-step diffusion-based perceptual video compression, reducing the sampling cost of diffusion decoders while maintaining perceptual quality. Li et al. [ 34 ] embedded temporal reference information into a one-step diffusion compressor to better exploit spatiotemporal correlations. Other methods improve controllability by transmitting compact semantic or structural cues. Wang et al. [ 35 ] used textual, appearance, and motion cues to condition diffusion reconstruction, and Wang et al. [ 36 ] introduced sparse semantic motion trajectories to guide generative video coding. paragraphs.en: Overall, existing generative video compression methods have substantially advanced low-bitrate video reconstruction by introducing powerful generative priors. However, they are mainly developed for natural videos, where the source is treated as an observed signal to be approximated under a bitrate constraint. Even with advanced video generation models, the selection and allocation of transmitted information are often guided by latent errors of the observed signal. This differs from AI-generated videos, where the source itself is a sample from a learned generative distribution and many local stochastic details are replaceable rather than essential. Therefore, AI-generated video compression requires a semantic-aware coding principle that prioritizes spatiotemporal information critical to content consistency.
paragraphs.zh: 总体而言，现有的生成式视频压缩方法通过引入强大的生成先验，显著提升了低码率视频的重建效果。 然而，这些方法主要面向自然视频开发，其中视频源被视为在码率约束下需要近似的观测信号。 即便拥有先进的视频生成模型，所传输信息的选取与分配通常仍由观测信号的潜在误差所引导。 这与人工智能生成的视频不同：在这些视频中，视频源本身是从已学习的生成分布中抽取的样本，许多局部随机细节是可替换的，而非不可或缺的。 因此，人工智能生成视频的压缩需要一种语义感知的编码原则，优先保留对内容一致性至关重要的时空信息。

paragraphs.en: Recently, AI-generated content has begun to receive attention in image compression. Duan et al. [ 40 ] studied neural compression for AI foundation model generated images and constructed PKU-AIGI-500K, a large-scale benchmark containing diverse prompts and images generated by multiple foundation models. Their benchmark shows that conventional codecs and learned codecs trained on natural images do not necessarily generalize well to AI-generated images, revealing a clear domain gap in generated-content compression. Duan et al. [ 41 ] further extended this benchmark study by analyzing the characteristics of AI-generated images and proposing a cross-attention transformer codec that exploits the relationship between generated images and their text prompts. Chen et al. [ 42 ] explored a different direction by using Stable Diffusion as a cross-modal decoder for layered AI-generated image compression. Their method represents an image with semantic, structural, and texture layers, showing that a generative model can act as a decoder when compact multimodal priors are transmitted.
paragraphs.zh: 最近，人工智能生成的内容开始在图像压缩领域受到关注。Duan 等人 [ 40 ] 研究了针对人工智能基础模型生成图像的神经压缩方法，并构建了 PKU-AIGI-500K——一个包含多种提示词和由多个基础模型生成的图像的大规模基准数据集。 他们的基准数据集表明，传统编解码器以及基于自然图像训练的学习型编解码器并不一定能很好地推广到人工智能生成的图像上，这揭示了生成内容压缩领域存在明显的领域差异。Duan 等人 [ 41 ] 进一步扩展了这项基准研究，通过分析人工智能生成图像的特性，提出了一种利用生成图像与其文本提示词之间关系的交叉注意力变换器编解码器。Chen 等人 [ 42 ] 则通过采用 Stable Diffusion 作为分层人工智能生成图像压缩的跨模态解码器，探索了另一种不同的方向。 他们的方法将图像表示为语义层、结构层和纹理层，表明当紧凑的多模态先验信息被传输时，生成模型可以充当解码器。

paragraphs.en: Generative video editing aims to modify existing videos according to text instructions or user-specified conditions while preserving source structure and temporal coherence. Early diffusion-based methods often adapt pretrained text-to-image or image diffusion models to videos. Ceylan et al. [ 5 ] proposed a training-free method that edits an anchor frame and propagates the edit through self-attention feature injection, showing that image diffusion priors can be extended to text-guided video editing. Zhang et al. [ 43 ] studied consistent video editing with text-to-image diffusion models and showed that newly introduced temporal modules may cause feature-space covariate shift, leading to temporal inconsistency and semantic disparity. Chai et al. [ 6 ] introduced temporal dependency into diffusion editing by propagating appearance information across frames with layered representations, improving consistency for edited objects. Feng et al. [ 9 ] separated structure and appearance control with multiple branches, enabling diverse edits such as style transfer, foreground modification, and background replacement. Mai et al. [ 7 ] developed an instruction-based video editing framework with flexible text, mask, reference, and temporal controls. Litman et al. [ 8 ] improved editing efficiency by focusing computation on local masked regions while using a lightweight global context module to maintain temporal consistency. Munir et al. [ 44 ] proposed a real-time streaming editing method with adaptive feature caching and motion-guided attention to reduce redundant computation while preserving temporal coherence.
paragraphs.zh: 生成式视频编辑旨在根据文本指令或用户指定的条件修改现有视频，同时保留原始结构和时间连贯性。 早期的扩散模型方法通常将预训练的文本到图像或图像扩散模型应用于视频。Ceylan 等人 [ 5 ] 提出了一种无需训练的方法，通过自我注意力特征注入来编辑锚定帧并传播编辑结果，表明图像扩散先验可以扩展至文本引导的视频编辑。Zhang 等人 [ 43 ] 研究了使用文本到图像扩散模型进行一致的视频编辑，并指出新引入的时间模块可能导致特征空间中的协变量偏移，从而引发时间不一致性和语义差异。Chai 等人 [ 6 ] 通过分层表示在帧间传播外观信息，将时间依赖关系引入扩散编辑中，从而提升了被编辑对象的一致性。Feng 等人 [ 9 ] 使用多个分支分离了结构与外观控制，实现了风格迁移、前景修改和背景替换等多样化的编辑操作。Mai 等人 [ 7 ] 开发了一个基于指令的视频编辑框架，支持灵活的文本、掩码、参考和时间控制。Litman 等人 [ 8 ] 通过将计算集中在局部掩码区域，同时使用轻量级的全局上下文模块来维持时间一致性，从而提高了编辑效率。Munir 等人 [ 44 ] 提出了一种实时流式编辑方法，通过自适应特征缓存和运动引导注意力机制减少冗余计算，同时保持时间连贯性。

paragraphs.en: These methods demonstrate impressive progress in controllable and temporally consistent video editing. A common property is that, given an input video, they need to analyze the video and construct conditions for prompt-guided generation. Depending on the method, such conditions may come from VAE latents, motion, or structural representations. Interestingly, these conditions are closely related to the information that a generative codec needs to transmit for preserving source content. This connection suggests that video compression and video editing need not be treated as two isolated stages. In our framework, the side information transmitted for compression is selected and allocated according to spatiotemporal semantic importance, and can therefore be reused as a controllable semantic condition for prompt-based editing.
paragraphs.zh: 这些方法在可控且时间一致的视频编辑方面展现了令人印象深刻的进展。 它们的共同特性是：给定一段输入视频，它们需要先分析该视频，并为提示引导生成构建条件。 根据具体方法的不同，这些条件可能来自 VAE 潜在变量、运动或结构表示。 有趣的是，这些条件与生成式编解码器为保留原始内容所需传输的信息密切相关。 这种关联表明，视频压缩和视频编辑不必被视为两个相互独立的阶段。 在我们的框架中，用于压缩的侧信息会根据时空语义重要性进行选择与分配，因此可以重新用作提示驱动编辑的可控语义条件。

sents.zh: 它们的共同特性是：给定一段输入视频，它们需要先分析该视频，并为提示引导生成构建条件。

sents.en: Depending on the method, such conditions may come from VAE latents, motion, or structural representations.
sents.zh: 根据具体方法的不同，这些条件可能来自 VAE 潜在变量、运动或结构表示。

sents.en: Interestingly, these conditions are closely related to the information that a generative codec needs to transmit for preserving source content.
sents.zh: 有趣的是，这些条件与生成式编解码器为保留原始内容所需传输的信息密切相关。

sents.en: This connection suggests that video compression and video editing need not be treated as two isolated stages.
sents.zh: 这种关联表明，视频压缩和视频编辑不必被视为两个相互独立的阶段。

sents.en: In our framework, the side information transmitted for compression is selected and allocated according to spatiotemporal semantic importance, and can therefore be reused as a controllable semantic condition for prompt-based editing.
sents.zh: 在我们的框架中，用于压缩的侧信息会根据时空语义重要性进行选择与分配，因此可以重新用作提示驱动编辑的可控语义条件。

paragraphs.en: The latent discrepancy contains both semantic information that should remain consistent with the source video and local generative variations that can be plausibly regenerated. Treating all latent positions equally may therefore spend coding capacity on replaceable details. We propose a spatiotemporal semantic importance-guided innovation selection method to determine what information should be transmitted. For each generation step and latent frame, the method constructs a position-wise importance map 𝐖 t , f \mathbf{W}_{t,f} and uses it to weight the latent discrepancy. Candidate atoms are then evaluated according to their ability to represent the semantically important components of the discrepancy while maintaining local temporal consistency. More details are presented in Section III-B .
paragraphs.zh: 潜在差异既包含应与源视频保持一致的语义信息，也包含可以合理再生成的局部生成性变化。 因此，若对所有潜在位置一视同仁，可能会将编码容量消耗在可替换的细节上。 我们提出一种基于时空语义重要性引导的创新选择方法，以确定哪些信息应当被传递。 对于每个生成步骤和潜在帧，该方法会构建一个逐位置的重要性映射 𝐖 t , f \mathbf{W}_{t,f}，并以此对潜在差异进行加权。 随后，候选原子将根据其能否在保持局部时间一致性的同时，表示出差异中的语义重要成分而进行评估。 更多细节将在第三节 B 部分中介绍。

paragraphs.en: The semantic coding demand is nonuniform across latent frames. Frames containing prominent structures, temporal changes, or substantial unrecovered information generally require stronger trajectory constraints than semantically stable frames. We propose a spatiotemporal semantic importance-guided bit allocation method to determine how much information should be transmitted for each latent frame. The method calculates a frame-level coding demand L t , f L_{t,f} , converts it into an allocation score ρ t , f \rho_{t,f} , and determines the corresponding innovation budget M t , f M_{t,f} . Thus, the innovation-selection method determines which atoms are transmitted under the assigned budget, while the bit-allocation method determines the size of that budget. More details are presented in Section III-C .
paragraphs.zh: 语义编码需求在不同潜在帧中并不均匀。 包含显著结构、时间变化或大量未恢复信息的帧，通常比语义稳定的帧需要更强的轨迹约束。 我们提出一种基于时空语义重要性的比特分配方法，用于确定每个潜在帧应传输多少信息。 该方法计算帧级编码需求 L t , f L_{t,f} ，将其转换为分配分数 ρ t , f \rho_{t,f} ，并确定相应的创新预算 M t , f M_{t,f} 。 因此，创新选择方法决定了在给定预算下传输哪些原子，而比特分配方法则决定了该预算的大小。 更多细节见第 III-C 节。

paragraphs.en: Given the transmitted bitstream, the decoder can operate in either source-reconstruction or prompt-based editing mode. We propose a spatiotemporal semantic importance-constrained unified reconstruction and editing method that treats the recovered innovations as controllable semantic constraints. For source reconstruction, the recovered innovations are fully applied under the null-text condition. For prompt-based editing, their contribution is relaxed while a user-defined prompt guides the generation process. The same bitstream can therefore support faithful reconstruction and structure-preserving editing without re-encoding the source video. Details are presented in Section III-D .
paragraphs.zh: 根据已传输的比特流，解码器可以在源重建或提示引导式编辑模式之间切换。 我们提出一种时空语义重要性约束的统一重建与编辑方法，该方法将恢复出的创新内容视为可控制的语义约束。 在源重建模式下，恢复出的创新内容会在空文本条件下被完全应用。 在提示引导式编辑模式下，这些创新内容的贡献会被弱化，同时由用户自定义的提示引导生成过程。 因此，相同的比特流可以在无需重新编码源视频的情况下，支持忠实重建和结构保留式编辑。 详细信息见第 III-D 节。

paragraphs.en: Conventional video codecs decode a compressed bitstream into a reconstructed video. If users subsequently wish to modify the reconstructed content, a separate editing model typically needs to analyze the video again, for example by encoding it into another latent space to recover the structure and motion required for prompt-based editing. However, the transmitted innovations already constrain the spatiotemporal semantics of the source video. Re-extracting this information from the reconstructed pixels introduces redundant processing and additional computational complexity.
paragraphs.zh: 传统的视频编解码器将压缩后的比特流解码为重建的视频。 如果用户随后希望修改重建的内容，通常需要一个独立的编辑模型来重新分析视频，例如将其编码到另一个潜在空间中，以恢复基于提示编辑所需的结构和运动。 然而，传输的创新已经对源视频的时空语义施加了限制。 从重建的像素中重新提取这些信息会引入冗余处理和额外的计算复杂性。

paragraphs.en: We therefore use the transmitted innovations directly as reusable semantic constraints for both reconstruction and editing. The main challenge is that the two tasks require different constraint strengths. Source reconstruction should fully preserve the recovered innovations, whereas prompt-based editing must relax their influence sufficiently for the new prompt to modify the content without losing the source structure and motion.

paragraphs.en: We use the MVAD [ 48 ] dataset for evaluation, which contains AI-generated videos from five representative video generation models: Kling [ 49 ] , Seedance [ 50 ] , Sora [ 51 ] , Veo [ 52 ] , and Wan [ 10 ] . Each model contributes 15 test sequences, resulting in a total of 75 sequences, which is comparable in scale to test sets commonly used in neural video compression studies [ 53 , 54 , 55 , 56 ] . The Kling sequences are evaluated at a resolution of 1920 × 1080 1920\times 1080 , while the Seedance, Veo, Sora, and Wan sequences are evaluated at 1280 × 720 1280\times 720 . For each test sequence, we encode and evaluate the first 99 frames. As illustrated in Fig. 5 , the test sequences cover diverse generated content, including human subjects and activities, natural landscapes, object-centric scenes, and animated content. This diversity allows us to evaluate the compression performance of our method across different visual appearances, spatial structures, and motion characteristics.

paragraphs.en: We measure the bitrate cost in bits per pixel (bpp) and evaluate reconstruction quality using DISTS [ 61 ] , FID [ 62 ] , LPIPS [ 63 ] , and peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR). We compute LPIPS using AlexNet as the feature backbone. Following [ 22 ] , we calculate FID on 256 × 256 256\times 256 image patches. PSNR primarily measures pixel-level fidelity, while LPIPS evaluates similarity in a learned feature space. However, PSNR and LPIPS metrics may not fully characterize perceptual quality under ultra-low-bitrate compression [ 64 ] , where perceptually plausible reconstructions can differ from the source at the pixel or feature level. We therefore focus primarily on DISTS and FID, which provide complementary assessments of structural similarity and distribution-level perceptual quality, respectively. We use BD-rate (%) to quantify the difference in compression performance between two codecs at equivalent reconstruction quality. A negative BD-rate indicates bitrate savings relative to the anchor codec, whereas a positive value indicates an increase in bitrate.
paragraphs.zh: 我们以每像素比特数（bpp）衡量比特率成本，并使用 DISTS [ 61 ]、FID [ 62 ]、LPIPS [ 63 ] 和峰值信噪比（PSNR）来评估重建质量。 我们使用 AlexNet 作为特征主干来计算 LPIPS。 遵循 [ 22 ] 的做法，我们在 256 × 256 的图像块上计算 FID。 PSNR 主要衡量像素级的保真度，而 LPIPS 则在已学习的特征空间中评估相似性。 然而，在超低比特率压缩 [ 64 ] 的情况下，PSNR 和 LPIPS 指标可能无法完全表征感知质量，此时在感知上可信的重建结果可能在像素或特征层面与原始图像存在差异。 因此，我们主要关注 DISTS 和 FID，它们分别提供了对结构相似性和分布级感知质量的互补评估。 我们使用 BD-rate（%）来量化两种编解码器在同等重建质量下的压缩性能差异。 负值的 BD-rate 表示相对于基准编解码器的比特率节省，而正值则表示比特率的增加。

paragraphs.en: Figure 7 presents qualitative reconstruction comparisons on Sora, Kling, and Wan test sequences. Our codec produces better subjective reconstruction quality across these diverse generation styles. Existing generative codecs such as GVC1D and YODA can obtain competitive perceptual metric scores (even achieve the best LPIPS performance for some sequences) and often reconstruct textures, repeated patterns, and background scenery reasonably well. However, they introduce noticeable semantic distortions. This failure is most evident in human face regions, where identity, facial geometry, and local structure can be changed even when the overall texture looks plausible. This semantic distortion appears across different types of AI-generated videos: the game-style Sora sequence, the animated Kling scene, and the realistic Wan scene all show visible face or identity degradation for existing generative codecs. In contrast, our codec better preserves both natural scene details and face semantics. This supports our central design principle: for AI-generated video compression, the bitstream should prioritize semantic structures rather than only producing perceptually plausible local textures.

paragraphs.en: Figure 8 demonstrates that the same compressed bitstream can support both source reconstruction and prompt-based editing. In reconstruction mode, the transmitted side information fully constrains the generation process toward the source video. In editing mode, relaxing the constraint strength allows a user-defined prompt to modify the desired visual attributes while the bitstream preserves the source spatiotemporal semantics. For the Veo off-road vehicle sequence, the editing prompt changes the vehicle color to red while largely maintaining the scene layout, vehicle trajectory, and camera motion. For the Seedance landscape sequence, the prompt transforms the video into a Van Gogh-inspired oil-painting style while preserving its spatial composition and temporal dynamics. For the Seedance cheese-cutting sequence, the prompt removes the visible text and logo watermark while retaining the appearance of the cheese, the cutting action, and the surrounding scene. These examples demonstrate that our framework supports fine-grained attribute modification, global style transfer, and localized watermark removal from the same bitstream, without re-analyzing the reconstructed video or introducing a separate post-reconstruction editing model.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate the effectiveness of the proposed spatiotemporal semantic importance-guided bit allocation (SSIGBA) by comparing it with uniform allocation, where the same number of innovations is assigned to every latent frame. As reported in Table II , introducing the proposed bit allocation method improves the BD-rate by 5.23% in terms of DISTS and 3.31% in terms of FID, demonstrating that distributing the coding budget according to frame-level semantic demand improves coding efficiency. To further understand this improvement, we visualize the semantic allocation scores, the corresponding frame-wise innovation budgets, and video frames of a sequence from the Sora class in Fig. 10 . The allocated budget varies consistently with changes in video content. In particular, the method assigns more innovations around temporal scene transitions, where the content changes substantially between adjacent frames. It also increases the budget for frames containing complex spatial structures, such as dense text and fine-grained details. These results show that the proposed method captures nonuniform coding demands across latent frames and concentrates coding resources on frames requiring stronger semantic preservation.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate the effect of the semantic constraint strength η \eta using a video from the Veo class as an example. The editing prompt is “Change the color of this lady’s shirt to purple.” As shown in Fig. 11 , we progressively decrease η \eta from 1 1 to 0.95 0.95 , 0.85 0.85 , 0.55 0.55 , 0.25 0.25 , and 0 0 . When η = 1 \eta=1 , the transmitted innovations are fully retained, resulting in faithful reconstruction without prompt-induced modification. At η = 0.95 \eta=0.95 , the shirt is successfully changed to purple while the original action and scene structure remain largely unchanged. When η \eta decreases to 0.85 0.85 , the color modification becomes stronger, but noticeable changes in the woman’s motion also begin to appear. Further reducing η \eta progressively weakens the source constraint and introduces increasingly substantial changes to the overall content and motion. At η = 0 \eta=0 , the transmitted innovations no longer constrain the generation process, and the output is primarily determined by the prompt and generative prior. These results demonstrate that η \eta provides continuous control over the trade-off between source spatiotemporal semantics and prompt-driven semantics, allowing the same bitstream to support faithful reconstruction and editing at different strengths.

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we presented the first unified compression and editing framework specifically designed for AI-generated videos. Rather than treating an AI-generated video as a fixed natural signal whose every detail must be reproduced, our framework exploits its generative nature by using a frozen video generator to restore replaceable variations while transmitting compact side information that preserves source-specific spatiotemporal semantics. Within this framework, we developed three spatiotemporal semantic importance-guided techniques to determine what information should be transmitted, how the coding budget should be allocated across latent frames, and how the transmitted information should be used for reconstruction and editing. Experiments on videos produced by five representative generation models demonstrate favorable rate–perception performance over traditional, neural, and generative video codecs. They further show that the same compressed bitstream can support both faithful reconstruction and structure-preserving prompt-based editing.
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们提出了首个专为人工智能生成视频设计的统一压缩与编辑框架。 我们的框架并未将人工智能生成的视频视为必须完整复现每个细节的固定自然信号，而是利用其生成特性：通过一个冻结的视频生成器恢复可替换的变化部分，同时传输保留源特定时空语义的紧凑侧信息。 在该框架中，我们开发了三种基于时空语义重要性引导的技术，用于确定哪些信息需要传输、编码预算如何在潜在帧之间分配，以及如何使用传输的信息进行重建和编辑。 在五种代表性生成模型所生产的视频上进行的实验表明，该框架在速率与感知质量方面优于传统、神经和生成式视频编解码器。 实验还表明，相同的压缩比特流既能支持忠实的重建，也能支持保留结构的提示式编辑。

paragraphs.en: These benefits currently come at the cost of relatively high computational complexity. For 720 720 p videos, the average encoding and decoding times are approximately 5.4 5.4 and 4.6 4.6 seconds per frame on a single NVIDIA RTX Pro 6000 GPU, respectively, mainly because both processes require iterative inference through the frozen video generator. This cost currently limits real-time deployment. However, recent advances in lightweight, on-device, and real-time video generation models [ 65 , 66 , 67 , 68 , 69 ] provide promising opportunities to reduce generative inference costs. Future work will adapt the proposed framework to more efficient video generators and optimize its sampling and innovation-search processes for resource-constrained and real-time platforms.
